mechanisms.mechanism_comment: Destabilizes microtubules and blocks cell cycle transition specifically at G2-M phase.

mechanisms.selectivity_comment: Interacts with the Tubulin heterodimer, but shows preference to Tubulin beta III in neurons.

mechanisms.mechanism_comment: Chromene analog that binds to endothelial microtubules promoting mitotic spindle destabilization, inhibition of tubulin polymerization and eventual induction of endothelial cell apoptosis.

mechanisms.mechanism_comment: VFL bound to tubulin induces structural changes favoring an inhibition of GTP hydrolysis and inhibition of microtubule assembly

mechanisms.mechanism_comment: The antibody binds to the B-cells, is internalised, and the linker proteolytically cleaved to release the small molecule which binds to microtubules inhibiting cell division and inducing apoptosis.
Binds to BCMA on normal B lymphocytes and multiple myeloma cells, is internalised and MMAF is released by proteolytic cleavage. MMAF binds microtubules leading to apoptosis.
